$comment: Drives installer/create-sdd-speckit-app/src/factory.js, which renders a native Factory Droid plugin into adapters/factory/dist/ from the Claude Code sources (commands/, agents/, skills/, hooks). The repo-root .factory-plugin/marketplace.json points Droid at that directory. Edit the sources, not the render. Formats checked against docs.factory.com (plugins, custom droids, skills, hooks) on 2026-11-13; see docs/FACTORY.md.

models.$comment: Claude Code tier -> Droid model id. A tier set to null writes `model: inherit`, so the droid uses the session's model.

tools.$comment: Claude Code tool -> Droid tool ids (case-sensitive). An empty list drops the tool. Droid always adds TodoWrite and Skill.

hooks.$comment: Droid tool names for the file-writing hooks. Claude's Write is Droid's Create.
